title: Erdős's Elementary Proof of Prime Divergence
description: Erdős's elementary proof that there are infinitely many primes via smooth number counting, without analytic infrastructure.

meta.author: Paul Erdős
originalContributions: Smooth number definition and counting framework
Proof that infinitely many primes exist via smooth number bound
Alternative proof path avoiding Mathlib's analytic machinery

overview.historicalContext: Erdős developed this elementary proof as part of his program to find 'proofs from THE BOOK' — the simplest possible proofs of fundamental results.
overview.problemStatement: Prove that there are infinitely many primes using only combinatorial counting, without real analysis.
overview.text: Elementary proof of infinitely many primes via smooth number counting.
overview.proofStrategy: By contradiction: if all primes ≤ N, then every integer is N-smooth. But smooth numbers up to n are bounded by √n · 2^{π(N)}, which is < n for large n.
keyInsights: Any N-smooth integer k = m²·s with m ≤ √n and s squarefree with factors ≤ N
At most √n · 2^{π(N)} smooth numbers up to n

conclusion.summary: Erdős's combinatorial proof of infinitely many primes is fully formalized with 0 sorries. Uses squarefree decomposition injection for the smooth number counting bound.
conclusion.implications: Demonstrates that the combinatorial core of Erdős's Σ1/p divergence proof can be formalized without any analytic machinery, complementing the parent proof's Mathlib-based approach.

sections.title: Imports and Proof Overview
sections.summary: Imports Mathlib basics (including Squarefree) and documents Erdős's elementary proof strategy.

sections.title: Smooth and Rough Number Definitions
sections.summary: Defines IsSmooth, IsRough, smoothSet, and primesUpTo.

sections.title: Squarefree Decomposition Infrastructure
sections.summary: Defines sqfPart/sqRtPart via Nat.sq_mul_squarefree_of_pos. Proves key lemma: squarefree positive naturals with same prime divisors are equal. Defines smoothInj injection.

sections.title: Smooth Count Bound
sections.summary: Proves |smoothSet N n| ≤ √n · 2^{π(N)} via injection into range(√n) × powerset(primesUpTo N). Fully proved, no sorries.

sections.title: Counting Rough Numbers and Multiples
sections.summary: Proves multiples_count (bijection with scaled range) and rough_count_bound. Fully proved.

sections.title: Infinitely Many Primes (Erdős's Argument)
sections.summary: Proves infinitely_many_primes_erdos by contradiction and derives prime_reciprocals_unbounded.
